LanguageData.LP_TrollBlood.label: troll blood
LanguageData.LP_TrollBlood.description: A vial of dark green blood drawn from a troll, still slowly writhing outside the body. Fire giants quench steel with it, and Black Network merchants say it sells to those seeking long life.\n\nObtained by performing "draw troll blood" surgery on a troll; trolls replenish the blood quickly.
